items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Tyree Glenn said once that Duke would listen to each new man that he'd hire and listen to them for maybe two months in the band before he would write for them or sometimes before he would even give them any solos --

ctx.x: But Duke studied all his men. He studied what their style, how they maneuver with their music, with their playing and everything and he keeps that in his mind so if he wrote anything for you, it fit you like a glove, you know, and you're really at home while you're playing it. It's not something that he just was taking it from his head and making it, trying to see how difficult he could make it or anything. No, it wasn't like that.
